actual_truth.incident: Poisoning, staged to look like a sudden cardiac event
actual_truth.motive: Varma had discovered Rana quietly falsified a dataset in his last major paper and told him, that week, that he intended to report it before the joint publication went to review -- ending Rana's chance at tenure.
actual_truth.method: Rana checked out a thiopental-derivative sedative vial from the lab's controlled-substance cabinet and slipped it into Varma's tea kettle around 9:50 PM, timed to look like a natural collapse after everyone assumed he'd already left for the night.

timeline.event: Rana tells colleagues in the break room he is leaving for the night.
Rana checks out a thiopental-derivative sedative vial from the cabinet, claiming it's for a calibration test.
Rana instead waits in the stairwell, avoiding the front desk camera's main sweep.
Rana badges into Room 4B using his still-active lab access, after Maya and Dr. Mehta have both left the wing.
Rana adds the sedative to the tea kettle Varma keeps in his office.
Rana leaves via the stairwell again, badging out at Side Door C, which has lower camera coverage.
Varma, working late, brews and drinks the tea.
Night guard finds Varma unresponsive at his desk during rounds.

contradictions.claim: Kabir says he left the building around 8:00 PM and went to a bar alone.
contradictions.evidence_fact: The keycard log shows Kabir badging into Room 4B at 21:47 and exiting via Side Door C at 22:05 -- with no earlier exit recorded anywhere that night.
contradictions.description: Kabir's stated alibi does not match his own keycard activity. He was still in the building, and inside the victim's private lab, nearly two hours after he claims to have left.

contradictions.claim: Kabir claims he doesn't remember checking anything out of the chemical cabinet recently.
contradictions.evidence_fact: The lab inventory log shows Kabir's staff ID checking out a thiopental-derivative sedative vial at 19:58 the night of the murder, which was never returned.
contradictions.description: Kabir has never accounted for checking out the exact class of sedative later found in Varma's system -- on the same night, and never returning it.

known_facts: He left Room 4C around 21:00 and badged out through the front turnstile.
He checked out and returned a sedative vial from the cabinet on Sept 10 for an unrelated animal-model trial, fully logged and returned the same day.
beliefs: Thinks Kabir has seemed oddly tense since last week's lab meeting.
Believes Varma was under a lot of stress about the upcoming publication deadline.
unknown_information: Does not know what happened in Room 4B after he left.
Does not know the exact cause of Varma's death.

known_facts: She left the building at 7:40 PM to catch a train and has a ticket stub proving it.
Varma repeatedly delayed signing off her overtime hours before payroll cutoff.
beliefs: Thinks Varma just kept forgetting the paperwork, not deliberately withholding her pay.
Suspects Vikram pressures Varma about deadlines more than people realize.
secrets: Her frustration over the unpaid overtime, which she's embarrassed about and worried makes her look suspicious.
unknown_information: Does not know anything that happened in the building after 7:40 PM.
Does not know who else was still around that night.

known_facts: He entered Room 4B at 21:47 using his still-active lab access.
He left through Side Door C at 22:05 specifically because it has lower camera coverage.
Varma confronted him privately the week before about falsified data in Figure 3 of their joint paper.
He checked out a sedative vial from the chemical cabinet that same night, claiming it was for a calibration test.
beliefs: Privately thinks Varma was going to ruin his career over what he considers a minor data-processing difference.
secrets: That he re-entered Room 4B after telling people he'd already left.
That he checked out the sedative vial and never returned it.
That he put anything in Varma's tea.
That Varma confronted him about falsifying data.
lies: Claims he left the building around 8:00 PM.
Claims he went straight to a bar alone and stayed there the rest of the night.
If asked about the chemical cabinet, claims he doesn't remember checking anything out recently.
unknown_information: Does not know exactly when Varma drank the tea or when he was found.
Does not know what the toxicology report says.

known_facts: She was at the front security desk from 6 PM until closing, reviewing camera feeds.
Side Door C is not covered by a working camera, only a badge reader.
She flagged a missing sedative vial during the routine morning cabinet audit on the 15th.
beliefs: Thinks whoever did this knew the building's camera blind spots well.
Suspects it has to be someone with existing lab access, not an outsider.
unknown_information: Does not know what happened inside Room 4B itself -- she only has badge data, not video, for that room.
Does not know the contents of the toxicology report.

known_facts: He was in a video call with the funding board from 7 PM to 9 PM, then left.
Varma's research was central to the Institute's funding renewal case.
beliefs: Worries this scandal could tank the funding renewal regardless of who's responsible.
Thinks the board will ask uncomfortable questions about lab security either way.
secrets: His private worry that Varma's death could jeopardize the funding renewal, which he doesn't want said publicly before the board reacts.
unknown_information: Does not know any specifics of the criminal investigation.
Does not know who had access to the sedative cabinet that night.

known_facts: She was in the library until closing, then went straight to her dorm.
She co-authored Varma's last three papers and relied on him for her thesis committee.
beliefs: Suspects some of Varma's colleagues resented how much attention his lab got.
Doesn't think any of the senior staff would actually hurt him, but isn't sure.
secrets: Her anxiety about whether she can finish her PhD now that her advisor is gone, which she's embarrassed to admit.
unknown_information: Does not know anything about the night's events after she left campus.
Does not know what was in the tea.
